listeningStage2Data.sentence: The clever boy won a big _______ because of his excellent test scores.

listeningStage2Data.translation: 那位聰明的男孩因為優異的考試成績贏得了一大筆獎學金。

listeningStage2Data.sentence: After sixty-five, my grandfather plans to _______ from his busy job.

listeningStage3Data.title: The School Cooking Contest (學校烹飪比賽)

articleContent.en: Yesterday, Leo and Amy decided to sign up for the school cooking contest.
articleContent.zh: 昨天，里歐和艾咪決定報名參加學校烹飪比賽。

articleContent.en: They were busy in the kitchen and had to focus on making fried rice.
articleContent.zh: 他們在廚房裡忙個不停，必須專注於做炒飯。

articleContent.en: Suddenly, Leo moved his arm quickly and began to spill water on the floor.
articleContent.zh: 突然，里歐手臂揮得太快，把水灑在了地板上。

articleContent.en: They could hardly finish the dish before the bell rang.
articleContent.zh: 在鐘聲響起之前，他們幾乎來不及完成這道菜。

articleContent.en: Luckily, they cleaned the floor and were ready to serve the hot dish to the judges.
articleContent.zh: 幸運的是，他們清理了地板，並準備好將熱騰騰的料理端給評審。

questions.question: Who decided to sign up for the contest yesterday?
What did Leo and Amy have to focus on making?
When did the two students enter the competition?
Where were Leo and Amy cooking their dish?
What did Leo accidentally spill on the floor?
How did they feel before the bell rang?
options: They were very rushed and could hardly finish
They were relaxed and had plenty of time
They were bored and fell asleep
questions.correct: They were very rushed and could hardly finish

listeningStage3Data.title: Grandfather's Art Project (爺爺的藝術計畫)

articleContent.en: Mr. Brown worked hard for forty years and chose to retire last month.
articleContent.zh: 布朗先生辛勤工作了四十年，並在上個月選擇退休。

articleContent.en: Now, his granddaughter Lily helps him film short art lessons in his studio.
articleContent.zh: 現在，他的孫女莉莉在工作室幫他拍攝簡短的藝術課程。

articleContent.en: Together, they carefully fold paper to make colorful paper birds every afternoon.
articleContent.zh: 每天下午，他們一起仔細地摺紙，製作五彩繽紛的紙鳥。

articleContent.en: Mr. Brown does not rely on expensive tools to create beautiful things.
articleContent.zh: 布朗先生不依賴昂貴的工具來創造美好的事物。

articleContent.en: Nearly fifty students watch their interesting videos online every day.
articleContent.zh: 每天將近有五十位學生在網路上觀看他們有趣的影片。

questions.question: Who helps Mr. Brown film the art lessons?
What do Mr. Brown and Lily fold together?
When did Mr. Brown decide to retire from work?
Where does Lily film the art lessons?
What does Mr. Brown make for his online students?
options: Short art lessons and paper birds
questions.correct: Short art lessons and paper birds

questions.question: Why do nearly fifty students watch their videos?
options: Because they want to learn interesting paper art
Because they want to win a big scholarship
Because they need to clean the room
questions.correct: Because they want to learn interesting paper art

listeningStage3Data.title: A Healthy Plan for Success (邁向成功的健康計畫)

articleContent.en: Sam wants to win a big scholarship to study at a great high school.
articleContent.zh: 山姆想贏得大筆獎學金去讀一所優秀的高中。

articleContent.en: However, he ate too much fried food at home and began to gain weight last winter.
articleContent.zh: 然而，他去年冬天在家吃了太多油炸食物，開始增加體重。

articleContent.en: His doctor told him not to rely on sweet snacks while studying.
articleContent.zh: 他的醫生告訴他讀書時不要依賴甜食點心。

articleContent.en: Now, Sam runs nearly three kilometers around the sports park every morning.
articleContent.zh: 現在，山姆每天早晨在運動公園周圍跑將近三公里。

articleContent.en: He can focus on his lessons much better after exercising.
articleContent.zh: 運動之後，他能夠更專注於他的功課。

questions.question: Who wants to win a big scholarship for high school?
What unhealthy habit caused Sam to gain weight?
options: Eating too much fried food and sweet snacks
Running too fast in the park
questions.correct: Eating too much fried food and sweet snacks

questions.question: When did Sam start to gain weight?
Where does Sam run nearly three kilometers every morning?
What does Sam hope to win for his future study?
How does morning exercise help Sam with his study?
options: It helps him focus on his lessons much better
It makes him feel very sleepy all day
It helps him fold paper faster
questions.correct: It helps him focus on his lessons much better

readingStage2Data.title: The Golden Feathers of Icarus (伊卡洛斯的金色羽毛)
readingStage2Data.article: Long ago, the master inventor Daedalus and his son Icarus were trapped inside a tall stone tower. To escape across the sea, Daedalus began to gather many {{1}} bird feathers and wax. He warned his son that the hot sun could melt the wax and cause the wings to {{2}} under strong winds. During their flight, Icarus was so amazed that he could {{3}} hear his father's warning shout. Driven by excitement, the foolish boy flew too close to the blazing sun, and his wings melted away into the deep blue ocean.

blanks.hint: 形容詞修飾名詞 feathers，表示「多采多姿的、色彩繽紛的」
blanks.translation: 為了渡海逃生，代達羅斯開始收集許多色彩斑斕的鳥類羽毛和蠟。

blanks.hint: 原形動詞，在此表示翅膀受力而「彎折、折疊損毀」
blanks.translation: 他警告兒子，熾熱的太陽可能會融化蠟，並導致翅膀在強風下折合損毀。

blanks.hint: 具否定意味的副詞，修飾動詞 hear，表示「幾乎不、簡直不能」
blanks.translation: 在飛行途中，伊卡洛斯驚嘆不已，幾乎聽不見父親警告的呼喊聲。

readingStage2Data.title: Marie Curie's Dream of Discovery (瑪麗居禮的探索之夢)
readingStage2Data.article: Young Marie grew up in Poland with a powerful desire to explore modern science. Her family was poor, so she worked long days to earn money and never dared to {{1}} on luck. She studied day and night until a special university offered her a precious {{2}} in Paris. In her freezing laboratory, Marie refused to stop her experiments, choosing to {{3}} entirely on chemical elements like radium. Her outstanding courage and lifetime dedication brought two Nobel Prizes and transformed the world of medicine forever.

blanks.hint: 動詞片語，表示「依賴、依靠」，後面接名詞受詞
blanks.translation: 她的家庭很貧困，因此她日以繼夜地工作賺錢，從來不敢依賴外在的運氣。

blanks.hint: 名詞，指由學術機構所頒發資助優秀學生的「獎學金」
blanks.translation: 她夜以繼日地學習，直到巴黎的一所特別大學為她提供了一筆珍貴的獎學金。

blanks.hint: 動詞片語，表示「專注於、集中精力於」
blanks.translation: 在寒冷的實驗室裡，瑪麗拒絕停止實驗，選擇全力專注於像鐳這樣的化學元素。

readingStage2Data.title: [歷史探索] The Postal Riders of Ancient Rome (古羅馬的郵政騎士)
readingStage2Data.article: Long ago, the Roman government built long stone roads across Europe to {{1}} its people and soldiers. Young messengers rode fast horses to deliver important letters and rarely had time to rest. Sometimes, heavy rain would {{2}} water over the muddy roads and make their journey very dangerous. Even when they were cold and tired, they kept riding day and night. When brave riders became old and chose to {{3}} after twenty years, the emperor gave them farmland and silver coins.

blanks.hint: 不定詞 to 後面接原形動詞，表示「服務」
blanks.translation: 很久以前，羅馬政府在歐洲各地建造了長長的石子路，以服務人民和士兵。

blanks.hint: 助動詞 would 後面接原形動詞，表示雨水「潑灑、溢出」
blanks.translation: 有時，大雨會把水潑灑在泥濘的道路上，使他們的旅途非常危險。

blanks.hint: 原形動詞接在不定詞 to 後面，表示工作多年後「退休」
blanks.translation: 當勇敢的騎士變老並在二十年後選擇退休時，皇帝會給予他們農地和銀幣。

readingStage3Data.title: The Golden Feathers of Icarus (伊卡洛斯的金色羽毛)

articleContent.en: Long ago, the master inventor Daedalus and his son Icarus were trapped inside a tall stone tower.
articleContent.zh: 很久以前，發明天才代達羅斯和他的兒子伊卡洛斯被困在一座高聳的石塔裡。

articleContent.en: To escape across the sea, Daedalus began to gather many colorful bird feathers and wax.
articleContent.zh: 為了渡海逃生，代達羅斯開始收集許多色彩斑斕的鳥類羽毛和蠟。

articleContent.en: He warned his son that the hot sun could melt the wax and cause the wings to fold under strong winds.
articleContent.zh: 他警告兒子，熾熱的太陽可能會融化蠟，並導致翅膀在強風下折合損毀。

articleContent.en: During their flight, Icarus was so amazed that he could hardly hear his father's warning shout.
articleContent.zh: 在飛行途中，伊卡洛斯驚嘆不已，幾乎聽不見父親警告的呼喊聲。

articleContent.en: Driven by excitement, the foolish boy flew too close to the blazing sun, and his wings melted away into the deep blue ocean.
articleContent.zh: 在興奮的驅使下，這個愚蠢的男孩飛得太靠近熾熱的太陽，他的翅膀在湛藍的汪洋中融化瓦解。

questions.question: Who built the special wings to escape from the tower?
What materials did Daedalus use to make the wings?
Where were Daedalus and Icarus trapped at first?
Why did Icarus ignore his father's advice?
options: He was too excited and amazed by flying
He wanted to catch fish from the sea
He lost his way in the dark clouds
questions.correct: He was too excited and amazed by flying

questions.question: What happened to the wax wings near the sun?
options: The hot sun melted them away
Heavy rain washed them into pieces
Strong sea monsters tore them apart
questions.correct: The hot sun melted them away

questions.question: How did Daedalus warn his son before they flew?
options: He told him not to fly too close to the sun
He told him to dive into the cold sea water
He asked him to wait until midnight
questions.correct: He told him not to fly too close to the sun

readingStage3Data.title: Marie Curie's Dream of Discovery (瑪麗居禮的探索之夢)

articleContent.en: Young Marie grew up in Poland with a powerful desire to explore modern science.
articleContent.zh: 年輕的瑪麗在波蘭長大，內心懷著探索現代科學的強烈渴望。

articleContent.en: Her family was poor, so she worked long days to earn money and never dared to rely on luck.
articleContent.zh: 她的家庭很貧困，因此她日以繼夜地工作賺錢，從來不敢依賴運氣。

articleContent.en: She studied day and night until a special university offered her a precious scholarship in Paris.
articleContent.zh: 她夜以繼日地學習，直到巴黎的一所特別大學為她提供了一筆珍貴的獎學金。

articleContent.en: In her freezing laboratory, Marie refused to stop her experiments, choosing to focus on chemical elements like radium.
articleContent.zh: 在寒冷的實驗室裡，瑪麗拒絕停止實驗，選擇全力專注於像鐳這樣的化學元素。

articleContent.en: Her outstanding courage and lifetime dedication brought two Nobel Prizes and transformed the world of medicine forever.
articleContent.zh: 她卓越的勇氣與一生的奉獻贏得了兩座諾貝爾獎，並永遠改變了醫學界。

questions.question: Who showed great passion for science despite poverty?
What did Marie win that allowed her to study in Paris?
When did Marie study hard for her scientific dreams?
options: Both day and night while working
Only after she moved to London
questions.correct: Both day and night while working

questions.question: Where did Marie conduct her groundbreaking experiments?
What chemical element did Marie focus on in Paris?
Why is Marie Curie remembered by historians today?
options: She won two Nobel Prizes and changed modern medicine
She opened the largest bookstore in Poland
She retired very early from the university
questions.correct: She won two Nobel Prizes and changed modern medicine

readingStage3Data.title: [歷史探索] The Postal Riders of Ancient Rome (古羅馬的郵政騎士)

articleContent.en: Long ago, the Roman government built long stone roads across Europe to serve its people and soldiers.
articleContent.zh: 很久以前，羅馬政府在歐洲各地建造了長長的石子路，以服務人民和士兵。

articleContent.en: Young messengers rode fast horses to deliver important letters and rarely had time to rest.
articleContent.zh: 年輕的信使騎著快馬傳送重要信件，幾乎沒有時間休息。

articleContent.en: Sometimes, heavy rain would spill water over the muddy roads and make their journey very dangerous.
articleContent.zh: 有時，大雨會把水潑灑在泥濘的道路上，使他們的旅途非常危險。

articleContent.en: Even when they were cold and tired, they kept riding day and night.
articleContent.zh: 即使他們又冷又累，他們依然日以繼夜地騎行。

articleContent.en: When brave riders became old and chose to retire after twenty years, the emperor gave them farmland and silver coins.
articleContent.zh: 當勇敢的騎士變老並在二十年後選擇退休時，皇帝會給予他們農地和銀幣。

questions.question: Who built the long stone roads across Europe?
What did the young messengers ride to deliver letters?
Where did the messengers deliver letters long ago?
options: Across the high mountains of Asia

questions.question: When did the brave riders usually choose to retire?
options: Before they were twenty years old
After only two weeks of work

questions.question: What made the stone roads dangerous during bad weather?
options: Heavy rain that spilled water on the roads
Wild tigers living in the forests
Big rocks falling from the sky
questions.correct: Heavy rain that spilled water on the roads

questions.question: Why did the emperor give farmland and silver to the old riders?
options: To thank them for their long and loyal service
Because they wanted to buy expensive clothes
questions.correct: To thank them for their long and loyal service
